Q: Please state your full name for the recording.
A: I'd rather not give my name on this one, just note that I was the driver of the vehicle.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the collision happened?
A: It was at an intersection in Conroe, Texas. I was going through on a green light when another car came across
from the side street.
Q: Which direction were you traveling?
A: I was heading straight through the intersection. The other vehicle was coming from my right and it hit the driver's
side of my car.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. I saw a flash of movement, maybe a half second before it hit. I tried to brake but there wasn't time.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was. The airbag deployed and I got pushed toward the door.
Q: Did you go to a doctor or hospital afterward?
A: The ambulance took me to the emergency room. They X-rayed my arm and told me the wrist was fractured. I've
got a cast on it now and I'm going to see an orthopedic specialist next week.
Q: Did anyone else in the car get hurt?
A: No, I was alone in the vehicle.
Q: Is there anything you want to add about the collision?
A: Only that I've been unable to work since it happened, since my job involves a lot of lifting and typing. I'm trying to
keep track of every bill and receipt.
Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you about the documentation you mentioned.
A: Okay, thanks.
</page>

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
